package lesson

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// UpdateLessonInput holds input values.
type UpdateLessonInput struct {
	LessonID            string
	Title               string
	Excerpt             string
	Description         string
	Translations        []domain.LessonI18n
	Versions            []domain.LessonVersion
	ComposeConfig       *[]byte
	Status              int
	LessonReadAccess    *domain.LessonReadAccess
	LessonReadAccessSet bool
}

// UpdateLesson updates lesson.
type UpdateLesson struct {
	Courses        repository.CourseRepository
	Lessons        repository.LessonRepository
	LessonVersions repository.LessonVersionRepository
	LessonI18n     repository.LessonI18nRepository
	Tasks          repository.TaskRepository
	TechVersions   repository.TechVersionRepository
	ComposeConfigs repository.ComposeConfigRepository
	Tx             repository.TransactionManager
}

// Handle performs update.
func (uc UpdateLesson) Handle(ctx context.Context, in UpdateLessonInput) (*domain.Lesson, error) {
	var lesson *domain.Lesson
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	if err := run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		var err error
		lesson, err = uc.Lessons.Get(ctx, in.LessonID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		versions := normalizeLessonVersions(in.Versions)
		for _, version := range versions {
			if uc.TechVersions != nil {
				if _, err := uc.TechVersions.GetByID(ctx, version.TechVersionID); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}

		translations := normalizeTranslations(in.Translations)
		if len(translations) > 0 {
			lesson.Title = translations[0].Title
			lesson.Excerpt = translations[0].Excerpt
			lesson.Description = translations[0].Description
		} else {
			lesson.Title = in.Title
			lesson.Excerpt = in.Excerpt
			lesson.Description = in.Description
		}

		if in.ComposeConfig != nil {
			composeConfig := domain.NormalizeComposeConfig(*in.ComposeConfig)
			if len(composeConfig) == 0 {
				if err := ensureLessonRuntimeCanBeCleared(ctx, uc.Tasks, lesson.ID); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
			lesson.ComposeConfig = composeConfig
			lesson.ComposeConfigID = nil
			if len(composeConfig) > 0 && uc.ComposeConfigs != nil {
				existing, err := uc.ComposeConfigs.GetByConfig(ctx, composeConfig)
				if err != nil && err != domain.ErrNotFound {
					return err
				}
				if existing != nil {
					lesson.ComposeConfigID = &existing.ID
				} else {
					title, description := domain.DeriveComposeConfigMeta(composeConfig)
					config := domain.ComposeConfig{
						ID:          uuid.NewString(),
						Title:       &title,
						Description: &description,
						Config:      composeConfig,
						CreatedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
					}
					if err := uc.ComposeConfigs.Create(ctx, config); err != nil {
						return err
					}
					lesson.ComposeConfigID = &config.ID
				}
			}
		}
		if lesson.Status != domain.LessonStatusActive && in.Status == domain.LessonStatusActive {
			if err := ensureLessonCanBeActive(ctx, uc.Tasks, lesson.ID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if lesson.Status == domain.LessonStatusActive && in.Status == domain.LessonStatusNoActive {
			if err := ensureLessonCanBeDeactivated(ctx, uc.Courses, lesson.CourseID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		lesson.Status = in.Status
		if in.LessonReadAccessSet {
			if err := domain.ValidateLessonReadAccess(in.LessonReadAccess); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			lesson.LessonReadAccess = in.LessonReadAccess
		}
		lesson.Versions = versions
		lesson.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()

		if err := uc.Lessons.Update(ctx, *lesson); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		if uc.LessonVersions != nil {
			if err := uc.LessonVersions.ReplaceByLesson(ctx, lesson.ID, versions); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}

		if uc.LessonI18n != nil {
			for _, translation := range translations {
				translation.LessonID = lesson.ID
				if err := uc.LessonI18n.Upsert(ctx, translation); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
		return nil
	}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return lesson, nil
}
